name: hud_ui_save_game_dialog_destructor
description: HudUiSaveGameDialog::Destructor tears down the save primary action button before freeing the shared Save/Load dialog file-entry vector, list item panels, widgets, and background base.
known_limits: Tier C only; Binary Ninja shows MSVC SEH scaffolding around the destructor, and tier S comparison is deferred to the Save/Load dialog class cluster.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x434a80 validates primaryActionButton destruction at offset 0xca10, operator delete on fileEntries.begin, clearing begin/end/capacityEnd, array destruction of nine entryWidgets through HudUiPanel::DestructorThunk, destruction of gameNameInput, prev/next/back/delete widgets, and final HudUiBackground::Destructor.

The native smoke constructs the owned SaveGame dialog members, allocates the file entry vector, invokes the destructor, and verifies vector clearing plus primary action button, entry panel, game-name input, and shared button teardown state.
